title: Enforcement Decree of the Framework Act on Railroad Industry Development

metadata.completion_statement: All supplied main text, Articles 1 through 51 including inserted articles and deletion notices, and all supplied addenda from Presidential Decree No. 18118 through No. 35947 have been fully translated into English. Consequential amendments, omission notices, historical names, dates, periods, amounts, and the cross-references appearing in the supplied source are retained. The translation is MACHINE_TRANSLATION / UNREVIEWED.
